title: GA rollout: SDK & API surface — launch telemetry, localized samples, and deprecation coordination
creator: Leah Moroz
description: Goal: Coordinate a safe GA rollout for the expanded SDK + API surface (function calling, structured output, streaming) with clear telemetry, localized sample coverage, and a deprecation schedule for legacy endpoints. Scope includes release notes copy, sample snippets in 4 languages, telemetry events & dashboard definitions, partner embargo coordination, and a staged deprecation window for the legacy 'responses.v1' endpoint. Acceptance criteria: (1) Release notes reviewed and approved by legal & docs, (2) SDK samples merged for Python/JS/Go/Ruby + localized translations (en/fr/de/es), (3) telemetry events instrumented and validated with Console dashboards, (4) deprecation notice drafted and scheduled, (5) rollout runbook and rollback playbook completed and reviewed by Eng and SRE.
